extraction.Name: Byron D. Wilde
extraction.Refused/Protested: No protest made by allottee and no signed receipt on file.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by letter from this office addressed to the County Auditor, signed by H. J. Davis, clerk.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No part of the land has been sold or mortgaged.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Taxes have been assessed against the land since Dec. 13, 1921.
extraction.Occupation/Income: engaged in stock raising and farming
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 611264; patent was delivered to patentee by F. E. Brandon, personally, 11-22-17; allottee is married and makes his home on this reservation; has received patents to other lands; is thoroughly competent to manage his own affairs and is one of the most progressive members of this reservation; has handled the property covered by patent in fees in a very creditable manner; has not been defrauded; has his wife and three adopted children; has not received support from the government, other than the benefits received by the entire tribe; is self-supporting; document dated December 27, 1928; Circular No. 2464.
